expectations.text: Recommends a one-quarter food-delivery-only Harbor pilot at $90 per month, leaving other programs on current calendars and requiring a named administrator, export rehearsal, and checked route mapping before launch.
expectations.evidence: 'Approve Harbor for a one-quarter pilot in the food-delivery program, conditional on a checked route mapping, a successful export rehearsal and a named administrator before launch.' Other programs retain calendars; later 'Harbor would cost $90 per month for this program; the trial was free.'

expectations.text: Retains the failed initial import affecting four volunteers, the inconsistent-route-name cause, its correction, and its relevance to migration readiness.
expectations.evidence: First-week CSV import assigned 'four volunteers to the wrong route because old route names were inconsistent.' Team corrected/re-imported and no wrong-route assignment remained after second import. 'Checking that mapping is a prerequisite for the pilot.'

expectations.text: Accurately uses the 24-volunteer trial, 19 link users and five phone users without inventing why phone users did not use the link or claiming phone handling is eliminated.
expectations.evidence: Two-week trial had '24 volunteers and two coordinators'; 'Nineteen volunteers accepted at least one shift through the link; five booked by phone, with a coordinator entering their shifts.' The record does not explain why; phone booking/data entry remained necessary.

expectations.text: Compares Harbor with the shared spreadsheet and separate calendars using their actual cost/conflict/reconciliation tradeoffs, without treating the two spreadsheet conflicts as a valid comparative rate.
expectations.evidence: Harbor showed conflicting assignments across two test routes. Protected-column spreadsheet avoids subscription cost and accommodates phone but needs manual conflict checking. Two conflicts were found in a one-week exercise; 'There is no comparable Harbor conflict-rate measurement.' Separate calendars avoid migration/subscription cost but retain email reconciliation and no combined conflict view.

expectations.text: Does not annualize the 11 observed reconciliation hours, claim measured Harbor time savings, assume proven export reversibility, invent an administrator, or supply unagreed numerical success thresholds; preserves the end-of-quarter stop/extend/expand review.
expectations.evidence: 11 combined hours over two observed weeks 'does not establish annual savings or how much time Harbor would save'; time savings not measured. Export/rebuilding rehearsal includes phone-entered bookings; reversibility not demonstrated. Director must name administrator and 'nobody has volunteered.' Quarter-end review covers time/conflicts/booking methods/admin workload to 'stop, extend or expand'; 'Numerical success thresholds still need agreement.'

expectations.text: Excludes slide orientation, icon preferences, and evenings spent polishing the presentation while retaining decision-relevant evaluation history and rationale.
expectations.evidence: No orientation, icon or presentation-polishing history appears. Import failure/correction, uptake uncertainty, alternative exercise, export gap and workload remain. Length is 365 whitespace-delimited words including title, within 300–420.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
